author: Codex
scope: One saved outer fold or two distinct saved outer/inner folds excluded; no repartitioning
parameter_constraints: Numeric, finite, positive; ppm_min<=ppm_max; no implicit estimation or fallback
future_estimation_rule: On exact-scope training rows only: normal capital 0<capital<=1e7; normal population nonempty; 1000*written_premium/capital finite and positive; store its min/max and population/source evidence. Not implemented or run in this work.
application_rule: Positive finite capital<=1e7 is preserved. Capital>1e7 is divided by1000 only if its ppm<ppm_min and 1000*ppm is in the closed interval[ppm_min,ppm_max]; otherwise suspect capital becomes missing. Invalid capital becomes missing. Natural log of resulting capital, no imputation.
premium_role: Audit-only quality dependency, never a predictor or target. No heldout values to estimate bounds.
provenance: Real artifacts require named author, zoned UTC, exact-scope producer receipt pinned by path/SHA and bound to the parameter payload. Synthetic constants have a distinct origin and cannot unlock real inputs.
producer_receipt_status: Absent; no real parameter producer or positive real receipt integration verified here
receipt_limit: Binding and receipt checks do not prove correctness of an external parameter estimate or establish approval
interface_output: Allowed-period features, original targets and claims, metadata and masked period schema for future C0; no C0, fitted preprocessing, model, calibration, price or score
learning_signature: Allowed input files/memberships plus capital artifact and feature contract only; protected payload hashes do not enter it. The separate archival request digest may change.
